moments.title: The Hundred Returns!
moments.blurb: The fast-paced, 100-ball cricket tournament, The Hundred, is set to kick off its 2026 season this week, bringing thrilling action to stadiums across the UK.

angles.name: Cricket buzz
angles.copy: Get ready for wickets, sixes, and super catches! The Hundred is back this weekend, bringing its unique brand of cricket chaos to a city near you. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Summer sport
angles.copy: Summer isn't complete without The Hundred! The tournament starts this Saturday, promising explosive cricket and a festival atmosphere.

moments.title: Love Island UK Finale
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated final of Love Island UK 2026 is scheduled for this Saturday, where the winning couple will be crowned and share the £50,000 prize.

angles.name: Final countdown
angles.copy: It's almost time! The Love Island UK final is this Saturday. Who do you think will be coupling up with the £50k prize?

angles.name: Last chance to vote
angles.copy: The villa drama is drawing to a close! Get your votes in for your favourite Love Island couple before Saturday's grand finale.

moments.title: New UK Singles Chart #1

angles.name: Chart update
angles.copy: Who's going to be number one this Friday? The race for the top of the UK Singles Chart is on! Any predictions?

angles.name: Weekend music
angles.copy: New music Friday means a new UK #1! What song deserves to be at the top of the Official Singles Chart this week?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Geddy Lee
moments.blurb: Geddy Lee, the iconic frontman, bassist, and keyboardist of legendary rock band Rush, turns 73 on July 29th.

angles.name: Rush legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 73rd Birthday to the one and only Geddy Lee from Rush! What's your favourite Rush track?

angles.name: Prog rock icon
angles.copy: Prog rock royalty! Happy 73rd Birthday to Geddy Lee, the incredible voice and bass behind Rush. Still rocking after all these years!

moments.title: Happy Birthday Kate Bush
moments.blurb: The influential and enigmatic British singer-songwriter Kate Bush celebrates her 68th birthday on July 30th.

angles.name: Wuthering Heights legend
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the truly unique and brilliant Kate Bush! From 'Wuthering Heights' to 'Running Up That Hill', her music transcends generations.

angles.name: Musical icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of an absolute legend, Kate Bush, who turns 68 today! Her artistry continues to inspire.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Fatboy Slim
moments.blurb: Norman Cook, better known as the pioneering DJ and producer Fatboy Slim, turns 63 on July 31st.

angles.name: Big beat legend
angles.copy: Right here, right now! Happy 63rd Birthday to the one and only Fatboy Slim! What's your favourite Norman Cook anthem?

angles.name: 90s icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of a true 90s icon, Fatboy Slim, who turns 63 today! Still bringing the funk to the big beach.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joe Elliott
moments.blurb: Joe Elliott, the powerhouse lead vocalist of the legendary rock band Def Leppard, celebrates his 67th birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Rock legend
angles.copy: Pour Some Sugar On Him! Happy 67th Birthday to Def Leppard's incredible frontman, Joe Elliott! What's your go-to Leppard track?

angles.name: 80s rock icon
angles.copy: Still rockin' it! Wishing a very Happy 67th Birthday to Def Leppard's legendary singer, Joe Elliott.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Butch Vig
moments.blurb: Butch Vig, the acclaimed drummer of Garbage and Grammy-winning producer behind albums like Nirvana's 'Nevermind', turns 71 on August 2nd.

angles.name: Producer legend
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to the legendary Butch Vig! Drummer for Garbage and producer of iconic albums like Nirvana's 'Nevermind'. What's your favourite track he's worked on?

angles.name: 90s sound architect
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of a true 90s music architect, Butch Vig, who turns 71 today! His influence on alternative rock is undeniable.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Dhani Harrison
moments.blurb: Musician and composer Dhani Harrison, son of George Harrison, celebrates his 48th birthday on August 2nd.

angles.name: Musical legacy
angles.copy: Continuing a legendary musical legacy! Happy 48th Birthday to Dhani Harrison, a talented artist in his own right.

angles.name: Contemporary talent
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to Dhani Harrison! A brilliant musician and composer, carrying on the family's incredible musical tradition.

moments.title: Happy Birthday James Hetfield
moments.blurb: James Hetfield, the formidable frontman, rhythm guitarist, and co-founder of heavy metal titans Metallica, turns 63 on August 3rd.

angles.name: Metal icon
angles.copy: Enter Sandman! Happy 63rd Birthday to the legendary James Hetfield of Metallica! What's your favourite riff from the metal maestro?

angles.name: Thrash pioneer
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of a thrash metal pioneer, James Hetfield, who turns 63 today! His voice and guitar define a genre.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Geri Halliwell
moments.blurb: Geri Halliwell, famously known as Ginger Spice from the iconic Spice Girls, celebrates her 54th birthday on August 6th.

angles.name: Spice Girls icon
angles.copy: Girl Power! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Geri Halliwell, our original Ginger Spice! What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

angles.name: Pop legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 54th Birthday to pop legend Geri Halliwell! A true British icon who brought 'girl power' to the world.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bruce Dickinson
moments.blurb: Bruce Dickinson, the legendary lead vocalist of heavy metal giants Iron Maiden, celebrates his 68th birthday on August 7th.

angles.name: Metal god
angles.copy: Up the Irons! Happy 68th Birthday to the iconic Bruce Dickinson, frontman of Iron Maiden! What's your favourite Maiden anthem?

angles.name: Heavy metal legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of a true heavy metal legend, Bruce Dickinson, who turns 68 today! His incredible voice defines a generation of rock.
